description: This file defines the interface for the OpenCDMSession class, which manages DRM sessions for media content, including methods for initialization, license handling, key management, and session control.

classes.name: OpenCDMSession
classes.description: An abstract class representing a DRM session, providing methods for license management, key handling, and session control.

methods.name: initialize(bool)
methods.description: Initializes the DRM session with a specified boolean parameter.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request based on the provided data.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the DRM session with a license.

methods.name: getChallengeData
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key is present in the session.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for the session.

methods.name: addProtectionMeta
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to a buffer.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a key.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Returns the last DRM error code.
